method: Visual inspection of all 42 annotated source pages at 1.5x, followed by all 65 actual 3x WebP crops in 17 two-column contact sheets (1400 px wide). Final top-border correction removes at most 1 PDF point of empty border. Separate 1800-px review sheets and unannotated 2x originals prepared for independent review.
limitations: Crop-content review only. No original transcription verification, answer re-verification, final-key certification or public redistribution rights clearance. Remaining papers are not crop-approved.
